name: Spellslinging (Magic Weapon Quality)
body:
Aura faint evocation; CL 8th; Price +1 bonus; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

These weapons were developed to aid arcane archers, though other spellcasters can find use in them as well. This special ability may only be placed on bows and crossbows. Once per round as free action you may sacrifice a prepared spell or expend a spell slot to add a bonus on the next damage roll with this weapon equal to the level of the spell or spell slot sacrificed.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Craft (any bow-craft) 5 ranks
